name: Stormwater
primary:
A wet shock: water amplifies lightning.
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 0.75 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 10 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 0.75 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
